home.styles.conditionalFormatting.note: Excel's menu: Highlight Cells Rules, Top/Bottom Rules, Data Bars, Color Scales, Icon Sets, New Rule, Clear Rules, Manage Rules. The boxes (Greater Than... Below Average) are dialog.cfQuick, More Rules and New Rule are dialog.cfNewRule, Manage Rules is the Rules Manager; the Data Bars, Color Scales and Icon Sets menus are drawn pictures of the rule (twelve bars, twelve scales, twenty icon sets) taken from the command state. Rules are the xlsx shape and round-trip. Not translated, and hidden: negative-value bar settings, borders on data bars, picking each icon of an icon set separately, number format codes beyond the rule format's Number page.

home.font.fillColor.note: The palette's More Colors… button opens the Colors dialog (Standard honeycomb and Custom), which applies to the fill.

home.font.fontColor.note: The palette's More Colors… button opens the Colors dialog (Standard honeycomb and Custom), which applies to the font colour.

home.font.borders.note: Draw Border, Draw Border Grid and Erase Border turn a pen on (one at a time, a second click turns it off); Line Color and Line Style set the pen's colour and line. With the pen on, the cells you drag over take the border: the outline of the area, its grid, or nothing (erase). The pen keeps to the document view and is not saved.

items.label: New Table Style…
items.note: Hidden: gridcraft has no custom table styles (no stored element formats, no painting of them); not translated.

items.label: New PivotTable Style…
items.note: Hidden: gridcraft has no custom PivotTable styles; not translated.

home.styles.formatAsTable.note: The tiles are the sixty built-in styles (Light 1-21, Medium 1-28, Dark 1-11) drawn with their header, line and band colours, read from the command state; a style formats the block around the active cell as a table, or restyles the table the cell is in, at once (Excel asks for the range in Create Table first: Insert > Table does). New Table Style… and New PivotTable Style… are hidden: gridcraft keeps no custom table styles.

items.label: Good, Bad and Neutral: Normal, Bad, Good, Neutral
Data and Model: Calculation, Check Cell, Explanatory Text, Input, Linked Cell, Note, Output, Warning Text
Titles and Headings: Heading 1-4, Title, Total
Number Format: Comma, Comma [0], Currency, Currency [0], Percent
Merge Styles…
items.note: U:grid/main: Merge Styles… brings the custom cell styles of another workbook the application holds into this one (the list is the application's own store, asked of the main process); not in gridcraft, not checked against upstream. A workbook picked through the Open dialog is not offered: custom cell styles are not saved in .xlsx files here, so such a file carries none.

items.label: Across Worksheets…
items.note: Hidden: Fill Across Worksheets fills the sheets that are grouped (tabs selected together), and Grid has no sheet grouping; gridcraft has no such command either.

items.label: Justify
items.note: Excel behaviour (not checked against upstream): the text of the first column of the selection is re-wrapped into the width of the whole selection, going down the column; text only, and the lines may not run into filled cells below.

items.label: Select Objects
items.note: Hidden: Select Objects is the Draw tab's lasso (draw.lasso), which Grid has not translated (gridcraft answers it with a no-op).

home.addins.addIns.note: Hidden: gridcraft has no add-ins (it answers that it extends through MCP and scripts); Grid has no add-in model to list or install from.

home.analysis.analyzeData.note: Hidden: Analyze Data is an online AI service with no gridcraft counterpart (commandStatus not-registered-upstream); not translated.

dialog.cfQuick.title: Greater Than
dialog.cfQuick.note: Opened by Highlight Cells Rules and Top/Bottom Rules with args {type, operator, rank, percent, bottom, below}; the title and the sentence before the box follow the rule (Excel's wording), "with" lists the six formats and Custom Format… (the conditional Format Cells, dialog.cfFormatCells). The value box starts with the active cell's absolute address.

Format cells that contain the text:
Format cells that contain a date occurring:
Format cells that rank in the TOP:

options.label: Light Red Fill with Dark Red Text
Yellow Fill with Dark Yellow Text
Green Fill with Dark Green Text

dialog.cfNewRule.title: New Formatting Rule
dialog.cfNewRule.note: Excel's New Formatting Rule (also Edit Formatting Rule from the Rules Manager): the six rule types, and the rule description each one has (2- and 3-color scales, data bar, icon sets with each icon's threshold; cell value, specific text, dates, blanks, errors; top or bottom; above or below average; unique or duplicate; formula). Format… opens dialog.cfFormatCells. Data bar border and negative values, and picking each icon of a set separately, are not translated and not shown.

options.label: Format all cells based on their values
Format only top or bottom ranked values
Format only values that are above or below average
Format only unique or duplicate values
Use a formula to determine which cells to format

fields.label: Format values where this formula is true:

dialog.manageRules.title: Conditional Formatting Rules Manager
dialog.manageRules.note: Excel's Rules Manager: Show formatting rules for (Current Selection, This Worksheet, each other sheet), the rules in the order they apply with their format, the cells each applies to (editable) and Stop If True; New Rule…, Edit Rule…, Delete Rule and the move buttons. OK and Apply send the sheets that changed to home.manageRules.

dialog.cfFormatCells.title: Format Cells
dialog.cfFormatCells.note: Format Cells as a conditional-format rule has it: Number, Font, Border and Fill, nothing set until a page sets it, OK gives the rule's differential format back to the rule dialog that opened it.

fields.label: Category:
fields.note: Upstream lists General, Number, Currency, Accounting, Short Date, Long Date, Time, Percentage, Fraction, Scientific, Text; Excel folds the two dates into Date with a Type list.

dialog.colors.note: Excel's Colors: the Standard honeycomb of 127 colours with the strip of 15 greys, the Custom colour square with Hex and RGB, New and Current side by side; OK applies the colour as the fill or the font colour, by the menu that opened it.

dialog.style.note: Excel's Style box: the name and Style Includes (By Example): Number, Alignment, Font, Border, Fill, Protection, each with the formatting the active cell has. The Format… button (changing the style from the box) is not shown: format the cell first, then make the style.

dialog.newTableStyle.note: Hidden: no custom table styles in gridcraft (see Format as Table); the dialog is not translated.

dialog.mergeStyles.note: U:grid/main: not checked against upstream. Merge styles from: the other workbooks the application holds; the check box replaces styles that have the same name.

fields.label: Replace styles that have the same name

dialog.fillAcrossWorksheets.note: Hidden: Grid has no grouped sheets to fill across (see Fill > Across Worksheets).
